name: Containment Control plan
summary: Survive the opening on cheap blockers, answer only what has to be answered, hold Energy open for Reactions, and win late on accumulated cards.

packages.label: Reaction suite
packages.rationale: The cards that require a turn to be spent doing nothing. Their value is entirely in being held, which no per-turn valuation can express and which is why the plan names them as a group.

packages.label: Containment removal
packages.rationale: Proactive answers, spread across Exhaustion, bounce, lockdown and a sweeper so the deck is not narrow against any one board.

packages.label: Reaction engine
packages.rationale: The Reaction Engine, Exhaustion Engine and Tempo cards: they make holding Energy cheaper rather than adding to the board, which is the only way this archetype gains tempo.

packages.label: Early blockers
packages.rationale: Cheap Defenders that hold the board while Energy is being kept open. Losing them is how a reactive deck dies before its answers matter.

packages.label: Card advantage
packages.rationale: Filtering, selection and draw. A deck that answers one threat per turn only wins by having more cards than there are threats, so this is the win condition as much as the finisher is.

packages.label: Late finish
packages.rationale: Two expensive cards the deck is trying to reach. Not core: the archetype is defined by surviving, and a search may find a different way to close.
